title: Depth-First Search on Graph Quiz
description: A quick check to review DFS on graphs.

questions.questionText: DFS explores a graph in which style?

options.text: As deeply as possible before backtracking
Only level by level with a queue

questions.explanation: DFS goes deep along a path before backtracking to explore other paths.

questions.questionText: Which structure can DFS use besides recursion?
questions.explanation: DFS can be implemented recursively or with an explicit stack.
